verdict.rationale: Wave is small-business accounting, invoicing and payroll software, not an AI agent or LLM host. Being an MCP client, one that plugs in MCP servers and calls their tools, is the agent role, so this axis does not fit this kind of product. Nothing in the evidence shows Wave ships any AI assistant or MCP-client capability that would make the axis apply, and its marketing pages document no MCP surface.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
